list_child.name: lst_chain_rsts
list_child.desc: This tool returns the complete list of shelf resets scheduled across every store in the chain. Use it when you need a full inventory of pending and completed reset work.

decoys.name: lst_vndr_rsts
decoys.desc: This tool returns the complete list of shelf resets scheduled by vendor merchandisers across the chain. Use it when you need a full inventory of supplier-led reset work.

decoys.name: lst_ssnl_rsts
decoys.desc: This tool returns the complete list of shelf resets on the seasonal set calendar across the chain. Use it when you need a full inventory of holiday changeover work.

decoys.name: lst_rmdl_rsts
decoys.desc: This tool returns the complete list of shelf resets tied to store remodel projects across the chain. Use it when you need a full inventory of construction-driven reset work.

get_child.name: get_rst_rec
get_child.desc: This tool retrieves a single shelf reset record using its unique identifier. It is useful when you already know which reset you want details on.

decoys.name: get_rst_pog
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves a single shelf reset's planogram using its unique identifier. It is useful when you already know which reset you want the layout for.

decoys.name: get_rst_cuts
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves a single shelf reset's cut-in list using its unique identifier. It is useful when you already know which reset you want new items for.

decoys.name: get_rst_disc
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves a single shelf reset's delist sheet using its unique identifier. It is useful when you already know which reset you want dropped items for.

list_parent.name: lst_chain_strs
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every store location registered in the chain's system, along with their basic identifying information. Use it to browse the full store roster.

decoys.name: lst_frnch_strs
decoys.desc: This tool lists every franchise store location registered with the chain's franchise office, along with their basic identifying information. Use it to browse the full franchisee roster.

decoys.name: lst_new_strs
decoys.desc: This tool lists every planned store location registered in the chain's real estate pipeline, along with their basic identifying information. Use it to browse the full new-store roster.

decoys.name: lst_clsd_strs
decoys.desc: This tool lists every closed store location registered in the chain's archive, along with their basic identifying information. Use it to browse the full closed-store roster.

get_parent.name: get_str_rec
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches the full record for one store location given its id. It returns the store's name and contact details.

decoys.name: get_str_lyt
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the floor layout for one store location given its id. It returns the store's aisle map and fixture counts.

decoys.name: get_str_sls
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the sales summary for one store location given its id. It returns the store's weekly sales by department.

decoys.name: get_str_crew
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the reset crew roster for one store location given its id. It returns the store's night crew names and shifts.

delete_child.name: rm_rst_rec
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a shelf reset record from the system, and the action cannot be undone. Use it when a reset was created in error or has been called off by category management.

decoys.name: rm_rst_tags
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes the shelf tags queued for a shelf reset, and the action cannot be undone. Use it when a tag batch was printed in error or has been superseded by new prices.

decoys.name: rm_rst_pog
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes the planogram attached to a shelf reset, and the action cannot be undone. Use it when a planogram was loaded in error or has been replaced by category management.

decoys.name: rm_rst_pics
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes the compliance photos uploaded for a shelf reset, and the action cannot be undone. Use it when photos were taken in error or show the wrong aisle.

set_enum.name: set_rst_phase
set_enum.desc: This tool changes the phase of a shelf reset to planned, staged, reset, or verified. It is the primary way to track a reset's progress through the workflow.

decoys.name: set_tag_phase
decoys.desc: This tool changes the phase of a shelf reset's tag batch to planned, staged, reset, or verified. It is the primary way to track pricing labels through the print workflow.

decoys.name: set_tgt_phase
decoys.desc: This tool changes the target phase a shelf reset should reach by its date to planned, staged, reset, or verified. It is the primary way to set goals for the reset crew.

decoys.name: set_vndr_phase
decoys.desc: This tool changes the phase of a shelf reset's vendor sign-off to planned, staged, reset, or verified. It is the primary way to track supplier approval through the workflow.

set_bool.name: flg_prty
set_bool.desc: This tool marks a shelf reset as a priority job that should be handled ahead of routine work. It is typically used when a reset is time-sensitive or requested by category management.

decoys.name: flg_ovnt
decoys.desc: This tool marks a shelf reset as an overnight job that should be handled after the store closes. It is typically used when the aisle is too busy for daytime work.

decoys.name: flg_adt
decoys.desc: This tool marks a shelf reset as an audit job that should be checked by a district auditor. It is typically used when a store's past compliance scores were low.

decoys.name: flg_vndr
decoys.desc: This tool marks a shelf reset as a vendor job that should be handled by the supplier's merchandisers. It is typically used when a brand has agreed to fund the reset labor.

set_ref.name: mv_str
set_ref.desc: This tool reassigns a shelf reset from one store location to another. Use it when a reset was logged against the wrong store or the work is being transferred.

decoys.name: lend_crw
decoys.desc: This tool lends a shelf reset's crew from one store location to another. Use it when a neighbouring store needs extra hands for an overnight set.

decoys.name: ship_fxt
decoys.desc: This tool ships a shelf reset's leftover fixtures from one store location to another. Use it when surplus shelving can be reused at a nearby store.

decoys.name: shr_pog
decoys.desc: This tool shares a shelf reset's planogram from one store location with another. Use it when a sister store wants the same layout for its own aisle.

send.name: msg_mgr
send.desc: This tool sends a message to a store's management team regarding a shelf reset. It is the standard way to notify store staff about work that needs their attention.

decoys.name: call_mgr
decoys.desc: This tool places a phone call to a store's management team regarding a shelf reset. It is the fastest way to reach store staff about work that is running late.

decoys.name: wrn_mgr
decoys.desc: This tool sends a compliance warning to a store's management team regarding a shelf reset. It is the formal way to cite a store for a failed reset audit.
child_verbs: send a compliance warning to the store for {obj}

decoys.name: svy_mgr
decoys.desc: This tool sends a feedback survey to a store's management team regarding a shelf reset. It is the standard way to collect store ratings on completed reset work.
child_verbs: send a feedback survey to the store for {obj}

create.name: new_rst
create.desc: This tool creates a new shelf reset for a store, with an optional category and starting phase. Use it when category management schedules fresh reset work.

decoys.name: new_rmdl
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new remodel project for a store, with an optional category and starting phase. Use it when real estate schedules a department refresh.

decoys.name: new_ssnl
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new seasonal set for a store, with an optional category and starting phase. Use it when merchandising plans a holiday changeover.

decoys.name: new_endcp
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new endcap display for a store, with an optional category and starting phase. Use it when a vendor funds a promotional feature.

list_notes.name: lst_rst_notes
list_notes.desc: This tool returns the notes attached to a single shelf reset. It includes every remark store staff and merchandisers have logged against that reset.

decoys.name: lst_rst_issues
decoys.desc: This tool returns the fixture issues attached to a single shelf reset. It includes every broken shelf or missing part crews have logged against that reset.

decoys.name: lst_rst_outs
decoys.desc: This tool returns the out-of-stock reports attached to a single shelf reset. It includes every empty slot auditors have logged against that reset.

decoys.name: lst_rst_audits
decoys.desc: This tool returns the compliance audits attached to a single shelf reset. It includes every score district auditors have logged against that reset.

add_note.name: add_rst_note
add_note.desc: This tool attaches a new note to a shelf reset, with an optional title. It is used to record remarks from store staff or merchandisers.

decoys.name: add_rst_issue
decoys.desc: This tool logs a new fixture issue against a shelf reset, with an optional title. It is used to record broken shelving or missing parts found by crews.

decoys.name: add_rst_out
decoys.desc: This tool logs a new out-of-stock report against a shelf reset, with an optional title. It is used to record empty slots found after the set.

decoys.name: add_rst_audit
decoys.desc: This tool logs a new compliance audit against a shelf reset, with an optional title. It is used to record a district auditor's findings.

update_note.name: edit_rst_note
update_note.desc: This tool changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a shelf reset. It is used to correct or expand a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: rply_rst_note
decoys.desc: This tool posts a reply, with an optional title, under an existing note on a shelf reset. It is used when store management answers a remark from merchandisers.

decoys.name: close_rst_note
decoys.desc: This tool closes out an existing note on a shelf reset with resolution text and an optional title. It is used once the problem in the remark has been fixed.

decoys.name: esc_rst_note
decoys.desc: This tool escalates an existing note on a shelf reset to the district manager, with a comment and an optional title. It is used when a remark needs a decision above store level.

delete_note.name: rm_rst_note
delete_note.desc: This tool permanently removes a note from a shelf reset, and the action cannot be undone. It is used to clear a remark logged against the wrong reset.

decoys.name: rdct_rst_note
decoys.desc: This tool permanently redacts the wording of a note on a shelf reset, and the action cannot be undone. It is used to strip personal details from a remark.

decoys.name: prg_rst_thrd
decoys.desc: This tool permanently removes a note and every reply under it from a shelf reset, and the action cannot be undone. It is used to clear a whole discussion from the record.

decoys.name: void_rst_audit
decoys.desc: This tool permanently voids a compliance audit logged on a shelf reset, and the action cannot be undone. It is used when an audit was scored against the wrong aisle.

set_image.name: set_rst_img
set_image.desc: This tool sets the image shown on a shelf reset record. It is typically a photo of the finished aisle taken by the reset crew.

decoys.name: set_rst_pog
decoys.desc: This tool sets the planogram diagram shown on a shelf reset record. It is typically the shelf layout drawing issued by category management.

decoys.name: set_rst_before
decoys.desc: This tool sets the before photo shown on a shelf reset record. It is typically a shot of the aisle taken by the crew ahead of the reset.

decoys.name: set_rst_sign
decoys.desc: This tool sets the aisle sign artwork shown on a shelf reset record. It is typically the overhead category banner printed for the aisle.

writer.name: write_txt
writer.desc: This tool writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the shelf resets it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_memo
decoys.desc: This tool writes a short store memo from a brief, which states the instructions in the requester's own words, and the shelf resets it should cover. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_recap
decoys.desc: This tool writes a short weekly recap from a brief, which states the progress in the requester's own words, and the shelf resets it should summarize. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_ad
decoys.desc: This tool writes a short circular ad from a brief, which states the promotion in the requester's own words, and the shelf resets it should feature. It returns the finished text.

image.name: gen_img
image.desc: This tool generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: pull_img
decoys.desc: This tool pulls an archive image matching a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: gen_pog
decoys.desc: This tool generates a planogram diagram from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the drawing.

decoys.name: gen_vid
decoys.desc: This tool generates a training video from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the clip.

search.name: srch_docs
search.desc: This tool searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the reset system works.

decoys.name: srch_pogs
decoys.desc: This tool searches the planogram library and category guides with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up where an item belongs.

decoys.name: srch_sops
decoys.desc: This tool searches the store operating procedures and safety manuals with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how a task is done.

decoys.name: srch_vndr
decoys.desc: This tool searches the vendor agreements and promo calendars with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up what a supplier has funded.
